description: Screenshot of Q drop #940 (10 Mar 2018) as displayed in a Q aggregator app, titled 'Antifa and Nazis Flag Photos'. The drop attaches a side-by-side comparison image of the 1932/1933 German Antifaschistische Aktion logo (red double-flag roundel) and the modern Antifascist Action logo (black/red flags on black roundel). The comparison's captions claim the logos represent the 'paramilitary wing' of the Communist Party of Germany (1933) and of the Democratic Party of America (2017); Q adds 'Coincidence?'.
text: 940. Antifa and Nazis Flag Photos. Q !UW.yye1fxo 10 Mar 2018 - 8:29:12 PM. 1933 Paramilitary Wing of the Communist Party of Germany. ANTIFASCHISTISCHE AKTION. 2017 Paramilitary Wing of the Democratic Party of America. ANTIFASCIST ACTION. BC185452-3F1B-493B-98D9-92....png. Coincidence?. Q
flags: The caption's claim that Antifa is the 'paramilitary wing of the Democratic Party of America' is an unverified partisan characterization, not fact
Historical framing of the 1933 logo as a 'paramilitary wing' is the image's claim

description: Promotional graphic for the Fox News program Hannity advertising an exclusive interview with President Donald Trump airing that night at 9 PM ET. Shows the Hannity show logo at upper left and a photo of Donald Trump in a suit with a red tie on the right.
text: HANNITY. EXCLUSIVE. PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP. TONIGHT 9PM ET
flags: Sean Hannity is referenced by the show logo only, not pictured

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated 9/8/18. Trump argues that Democrats have called him names yet he beat them 306-223 (electoral votes) and claims they are 'going CRAZY' because they cannot beat him in 2020.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. The Dems have tried every trick in the playbook-call me everything under the sun. But if I'm all of those terrible things, how come I beat them so badly, 306-223? Maybe they're just not very good! The fact is they are going CRAZY only because they know they can't beat me in 2020!. 9/8/18, 8:47 PM
flags: The 306-223 figure is Trump's claim; the certified 2016 electoral count was 304-227 after faithless electors

description: Digital graphic of the 'Thin Blue Line' flag: a black-and-white United States flag with one stripe rendered in blue. The symbol is commonly used to express support for law enforcement.

Annotated side-by-side 'Q proof' collage on a gray background with a faint Punisher-skull watermark. Top: screenshot of Q drop #4450 (Jun 10 2020) reading 'Do Anons understand what is about to be unleashed?' with 'unleashed' underlined in green. Bottom: screenshot of a verified Mike Pompeo tweet (Jun 12 2020) captioned 'Mercer' with three photos of a golden retriever puppy holding its own teal leash; the dangling leash is circled in green and both dates are underlined in red. The annotations imply the tweet is a coded response to the Q drop.
text: Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 ID: dfa70c No.9567180. 4450. Jun 10 2020 20:10:38 (EST). Do Anons understand what is about to be unleashed?. Q. Mike Pompeo. @mikepompeo. Mercer. 7:55 PM - Jun 12, 2020 - Twitter for iPhone
flags: The implied connection between the Q drop and Pompeo's dog tweet is the collage's unverified claim
